title: PriMa-Causa: Causal Prescriptive Maintenance
abstract: arXiv:2610.31147v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated manufacturing requires data-driven decisions under uncertainty and sparse observational records, and unplanned downtime is a dominant cost of getting them wrong. Prescriptive maintenance recommends a maintenance action against an impending failure rather than merely predicting it. Established reference architectures couple predictive models with rule- or optimisation-based recommendation logic. Selecting a corrective action, however, requires an interventional quantity: how the line behaviour would change if the action were set. Manufacturing data is observational, so a model fitted to predict the outcome estimates an associational quantity and may misdirect the choice of action without the prediction error revealing it. translated_abstract: 自动化制造需要在不确定性和稀疏观测记录下做出数据驱动的决策，而非计划停机是决策失误最主要的代价。处方式维护（prescriptive maintenance）针对即将发生的故障推荐维护措施，而不仅仅是预测故障。既有的参考架构将预测模型与基于规则或优化的推荐逻辑相耦合。然而，选择纠正措施需要一个干预量：即如果设定了该措施，产线行为将如何变化。由于制造数据是观测性的，拟合用于预测结果的模型所估计的是关联量，可能会误导措施的选择，而预测误差却无法揭示这一问题。因果估计器以干预量为目标，但需要对每个案例进行专家主导的因果研究，而运行时的有限决策窗口并不允许这样做。本文分析了如何将因果推……
tldr: 论文指出处方式维护中纠正措施的选择本质上需要干预性因果量而非关联性预测，观测数据训练的预测模型会误导维护决策，因此应将因果推理嵌入处方式维护架构。
en_tdlr: This dissertation argues that selecting corrective maintenance actions requires interventional (causal) quantities rather than associational predictions—since models fitted on observational manufacturing data can misdirect action choice—and analyses how causal reasoning can be integrated into prescriptive maintenance.
